name: pet-dragon
description: Dragon, a little winged dragon, above your prompt: it changes color with the Claude session state (and dozes off when idle), shows Jira / Bitbucket / Outlook / Teams / CoreAPI / git / pipeline / test / Seq status lights, offers related skills before you send a prompt, and writes your standup with /dragon standup.

bff_port.title: BFF port
bff_port.description: Local port the BFF listens on (checked with CoreAPI)

movedocs_port.title: MoveDocs API port
movedocs_port.description: Local port the MoveDocs API listens on (checked with CoreAPI)

coreapi_poll_seconds.title: Local API check interval (seconds)
coreapi_poll_seconds.description: How often to check CoreAPI (and its database), the BFF, and the MoveDocs API

messages_poll_seconds.title: Mail/Teams check interval (seconds)
messages_poll_seconds.description: How often to check Outlook unread mail and whether Teams is running

jira_poll_minutes.title: Jira check interval (minutes)
jira_poll_minutes.description: How often to count your open Jira issues

bitbucket_poll_minutes.title: Bitbucket check interval (minutes)
bitbucket_poll_minutes.description: How often to count your open authored PRs

jira_jql.title: Jira JQL
jira_jql.description: Which issues the Jira light counts

context_warn_percent.title: Context warning (%)
context_warn_percent.description: Turn Dragon purple when the context window is this full

sleepy_after_minutes.title: Sleepy after (minutes)
sleepy_after_minutes.description: Dragon falls asleep after this long with no typing, turns or tool calls. 0 = never

git_poll_seconds.title: Git check interval (seconds)
git_poll_seconds.description: How often to read git status (dirty, ahead, behind)

pipeline_poll_minutes.title: Pipelines check interval (minutes)
pipeline_poll_minutes.description: How often to read the latest Bitbucket pipeline for your branch

bitbucket_repo.title: Bitbucket repository
bitbucket_repo.description: workspace/repo whose pipelines the CI light reads

seq_url.title: Seq URL
seq_url.description: Where Seq listens; the Seq light counts recent errors there

seq_api_key.title: Seq API key
seq_api_key.description: Only needed if your Seq requires one to read events

seq_poll_seconds.title: Seq check interval (seconds)
seq_poll_seconds.description: How often to count recent Seq errors

seq_window_minutes.title: Seq error window (minutes)
seq_window_minutes.description: The Seq light counts Error and Fatal events from this many minutes back

skill_suggestions.title: Skill suggestions
skill_suggestions.description: ask = offer related skills before a prompt is sent; off = never

skill_min_score.title: Skill suggestion sensitivity
skill_min_score.description: Lower suggests more often. A skill-name word match scores 3, a description word 1.
